info.cozychristmas.present: Presents turn up in the snow and under Christmas trees in December, Santa hands one out each day, and chests hold them. What's inside depends on the karma of whoever comes close first: a gift for the nice, coal for the naughty, and now and then a bang. One that ticks when you come near is a prank. Wrapped presents hold what someone wrapped and say who it's from.
info.cozychristmas.wrapping_table: Put anything in with a sheet of paper and pick a design: you get a present that says it's from you. Wrap TNT and it's a prank that goes off in the opener's face (blocks stay whole). Giving presents raises your karma, once a day.
info.cozychristmas.stocking: Hang it on the wall above a fireplace. On Christmas-season mornings it holds a present, or coal if you've been naughty: one stocking per player each morning, and only its owner can empty it.
info.cozychristmas.fireplace: Light it with flint and steel, put it out with a shovel. Stockings hung above it fill on Christmas mornings, and evil snowmen melt near a lit one.
info.cozychristmas.tree_star: Put it on top of a tree (leaves on a trunk) with at least six ornaments. Every Christmas-season morning a present waits under it for whoever put the star up, and their karma decides what's inside. One tree per player a morning, at most three presents at a time. Click the star to see how the tree is doing.
info.cozychristmas.ornament: Hangs on leaves, from below or from the side, or sits on top of a block. A Christmas tree needs at least six under its star.
info.cozychristmas.toasty_set: Wear a sweater, a hat (pompom hat or ear warmers), a scarf and mittens together: powder snow can't freeze you and you walk faster on snow.
info.cozychristmas.chestnuts: Now and then they fall from dark oak leaves. Roast them on a campfire.
info.cozychristmas.hot_cocoa: Warms you through: thaws you and keeps the frost off for two minutes, even in powder snow or under a hail of ice snowballs. The mug comes back.
info.cozychristmas.gingerbread_cookie: Gingerbread men crumble into them. Elves follow whoever holds one.
info.cozychristmas.ice_snowball: Evil snowmen throw these and drop them. A hit hurts, slows and chills; warm clothes keep the chill out. Dispensers fire them too.
info.cozychristmas.krampus_trophies: Only from Krampus, who waits in a lair under a pit in the snow, high in the mountains. Beating him also wipes out the bad karma of everyone who fought.
